title: Enquiry from the DUtch Consulate General re Mr Z. Shevschook and Mrs I. Shevschook

SHANGHAI. 7 Dec. 1933.

Sir,

I wish to acknowledge the receipt of your
letter of the 6th instant, No. D. 5509, regarding
Mr. & Mrs. Shevchook, and to thank you for
the information contained therein.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Chinese Secretary.

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

December 6 33.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter No. 3556 of November 30, 1933, and to state
that there is nothing in the Police records against
either Mr. Z. Shevchook or his wife, Mrs. Isabella
Shevchook who desire to travel to Netherlands India.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

〔此处转录不清：手写签名〕

Officer i/c Special Branch.

J. Van den Berg, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.
page_data.zh:
〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写编号〕

1933年12月6日。

先生：

谨此确认收到您1933年11月30日的第3556号来信，并声明在警方档案中，没有任何针对希望前往荷属东印度的 Z. 谢夫丘克（Z. Shevchook）先生或其妻子伊莎贝拉·谢夫丘克（Isabella Shevchook）夫人的不利记录。

谨致
敬礼，

先生，

您的恭顺仆人，

〔此处转录不清：手写签名〕

特别股主管警官。

J. Van den Berg 先生，
荷兰驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3556.

〔右上角印章及手写内容：... MUNICIPAL ... / C. S. B. REGI ... / No. D 5509 / Date 11/2/34〕

SHANGHAI, 30 November 1933.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that the American Lloyd
(13 Edward Ezra Road) has applied for visa for admission
into Netherlands India of Mr. and Mrs. Shevchook about whom
the following particulars were noted :

Z. Shevchook, musician Shanghai Municipal Orchestra, 30 years
of age, born at Kerch, former Russian, passport issued by
local Bureau of Public Safety on 24 November 1933, No. 179048,
special No. 2725.

Mrs. Isabella Shevchook, hairdresser, 25 years of age, born
in Germany, passport issued by same Bureau, same date, No.
179049/2696. They are proceeding on leave to Europe and
intend, on their way back, to break the journey in Singapore
on 25 September 1934, then go to Java and reembark in Sin-
gapore on the s.s. Conte Rosso leaving from there on 30
October 1934 to Shanghai.

I would be much obliged to be informed whether anything
is known against these persons from a political or moral
point of view.

〔左侧手写批注：S. 2 / JR / B.S.O. Parkfield / 4/1/34〕

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕
Chinese Secretary.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号 HOLLANDIA。

编号 3556。

〔右上角印章及手写内容：... 市政 ... / C. S. B. 登记 ... / 编号 D 5509 / 日期 34年2月11日〕

上海，1933年11月30日。

先生：

谨此通知您，美国劳埃德公司（American Lloyd，地址：爱多亚路13号）已为谢夫丘克（Shevchook）夫妇申请进入荷属东印度的签证，记录在案的具体信息如下：

Z. 谢夫丘克（Shevchook），音乐家，上海公共乐队成员，30岁，生于刻赤（Kerch），前俄罗斯籍，护照由当地公安局于1933年11月24日签发，编号 179048，特别编号 2725。

伊莎贝拉·谢夫丘克（Isabella Shevchook）夫人，美发师，25岁，生于德国，护照由同一机构于同日签发，编号 179049/2696。他们正休假前往欧洲，并计划在返程途中于1934年9月25日在新加坡停留，随后前往爪哇，并于1934年10月30日搭乘从新加坡开往上海的“孔特·罗索”号（Conte Rosso）轮船再次启程。

如能从政治或道德角度获悉是否有任何针对这些人的不良记录，本人将不胜感激。

〔左侧手写批注：S. 2 / JR / B.S.O. Parkfield / 34年1月4日〕

T. P. Givens 先生，
特别股主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

谨致
敬礼，

先生，

您的恭顺仆人，

〔签名〕
华务秘书。
